titleTr: Dönem sonuna kadar: will have + V3

explainTr: Gelecekteki bir zamana kadar tamamlanmış olacak eylemi anlatır: will have + V3. By the end of the semester, I will have finished the course. (Dönem sonuna kadar kursu bitirmiş olacağım.)

Çoğu zaman 'by' ile gelir: by Friday, by June, by the end of the year, by the time you arrive. Önemli olan, eylemin o tarihten önce bitmiş olmasıdır; o tarihte hâlâ yapıyor olmak değildir (bu future continuous olurdu).
Olumsuz: won't have finished. Soru: Will you have finished by Monday? Süreyi vurgulamak için 'for' ile de kullanılır: By March, I will have lived here for three years.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Cuma'ya kadar bitirmiş olacağım' tek bir ek ile kurulur. İngilizcede üç parça var: will + have + finished. 'Bitirmiş olacağım' = I will have finished.
table: by Friday, by the end of..., by the time
By June, I will have graduated.

reading.title: Hafsa's calendar
reading.text:
Hafsa taped a large calendar to the refrigerator door. At the top, in red ink, she had written one sentence: "By the end of the semester, I will have become a real substitute teacher." Emre, who was eating cereal, read it aloud and smiled. "That's a big goal, Mom. Do you have a plan?"

"Of course," Hafsa said. She pointed at the calendar. "By the end of November, I will have finished the online course about classroom management. By the middle of December, I will have completed the background check and sent my transcript to the district. And by January, I hope I will have received my substitute license."

Emre counted on his fingers. "That's three milestones in two months." "Four," she said. "By the end of the semester, I will also have worked at least ten days in different schools. Mr. Brown says that experience matters more than any certificate."

"What about your English?" Emre asked carefully. Hafsa did not feel hurt. "By January I will have learned five hundred new words and read twenty short articles," she said. "I will have taken three practice tests, too." Emre was impressed. "You have thought about everything." "Not everything," she said. "I haven't decided what I will do if I fail the test." "Then you will take it again," Emre said. "By then you will have improved so much that it won't matter anyway."

Hafsa laughed and drew a small green star next to the last date. She knew that not every plan would work perfectly. Some weeks she would be too tired, and some days a class would be difficult. But when she looked at the calendar, she no longer saw a mountain. She saw a staircase. By the time winter break arrived, she would have climbed most of it, one step at a time.

writing.promptTr: Dönem sonuna ya da yıl sonuna kadar neleri tamamlamış olacağını anlat. Will have + V3 ile en az dört cümle kur.
writing.promptEn: Write a paragraph (120-180 words) about what you will have achieved by the end of the year. Use the future perfect at least four times.
frames: By the end of the year, I will have ...
By June, I will have ... for ... months.
I won't have ... by then, but ...
By the time ..., I will have ...
writing.model: By the end of this year, I will have achieved several important goals. First, I will have finished my English course, and I will have learned about two thousand new words. By June, I will have taken three practice tests, and I hope I will have passed the WUST test with a good score. I will also have completed the training that the district requires, so I will be able to work as a substitute teacher. By the time winter break arrives, I will have worked in at least eight classrooms, and I will have met many kind teachers. Of course, I won't have solved every problem. My pronunciation will still be difficult, and I will sometimes be nervous. But I will have become more confident, and I will have proved to myself that I can learn at any age. My son Emre will be proud, and so will I.
checklistTr: En az dört yerde will have + V3 var mı?
'By' ile gelecekteki bir tarih ya da zaman verdin mi?
Bir yerde won't have + V3 kullandın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
